purpose: Factory workshop and dated retail evidence of the information and equipment needed BEFORE ordering specific parts or asserting DIY workability; VIN/case/quotes missing.

source_records.title: Saab 9-5 9600 MY2000 original AF30/FA47 type identification
source_records.fact: MY2000 FA47 example labels manufacturer/engine adaptation and serial; AF30 is family, not an interchangeable donor assembly.

source_records.title: Saab 9-5 MY2008 FA57 case-tag format
source_records.fact: FA57 C01 example includes engine adaptation, development version, year/month and unit serial; differs from 9-3 FA57 tag.

source_records.title: Saab 9-3 MY2006 FA57 gearbox and TCM identification
source_records.fact: FA57 1 01 style engine adaptation B207E/L/R, manufacturer TCM hardware and engine-specific letter J/K/L; NOT the original 9-5 tag format.

source_records.title: Saab MY2006 9-3 FA57 temperature/Tech2 level inspection
source_records.fact: MY2006 WIS requires Tech2 TCM ATF reading at 80C, dipstick O-ring removal for a reading, filler 87 92 822; not a nonrunning-car dipstick guess.

source_records.title: Saab TA440-0902 MY2006 9-3 AF40 level protocol
source_records.fact: Bulletin January 2009 all-market AF40 delayed shifts/low fluid; 70–80C TCM Tech2 with running engine, level lift, new seal ring; unlike MY2006 FA57 dipstick.

source_records.title: Saab MY2006 B284 AF40 gearbox pressure diagnostic equipment
source_records.fact: WIS B284 AF40 pressure test explicitly requires 87 92 301 adapter and 87 91 600 pressure gauge, TECH2, torque rod refitted, hot gearbox. Full-load stall-style testing is NOT recommended for uninspected project car.

source_records.title: Saab MY2008 B235 left engine mount tooling and VIN torque split
source_records.fact: Requires engine support beam 83 94 850. WIS gives different fastening-nut torque for VIN up to 73514478 vs from 73514479; this is a procedure fork not proof of different mount SKU.

source_records.title: Saab MY2008 B235 right engine mount engine support
source_records.fact: Saab MY2008 WIS requires 83 94 850 lifting beam for RH mount and pad; not a zero-support driveway fastener job.

source_records.title: Saab MY2011 NG9-5 legal VIN engine and FWD automatic codes
source_records.fact: VIN pos7 A=FWD six-speed AT; pos8 Z=2.0T A20NFT/LHU, R=BioPower A20NFT/LHU; exact installed vehicle case tag still required.

source_records.title: Saab MY2011 NG9-5 AF40-6 physical gearbox identification
source_records.fact: Factory WIS describes AF40-6 transmission identification; confirm casing and actual MY2011 Turbo4 VIN/RPO; not a 9-3 AF40 donor swap approval.

source_records.title: eSaabParts dated 2026-10-13 aftermarket Nissens radiator 32019620 retail listing
source_records.fact: Existing data/datasets/us-retail-parts-supply-snapshot.json recorded a $211.98 quote on 2026-10-13 and variable inventory. Supplier is not manufacturer fitment certification or a current stock quote.

Saab-compatible TCM diagnostics for shifting concerns

Donor complete gearbox part interchange not established by 'AF30' or 4AT

job_packets.name: 2008 9-5 B235 left and right engine mounting repair
